meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card that says what will happen, the folder (Shared Drive / Archive / 2019), the number of files (214, all older than 2020) and the space freed (3.2 GB), and that it cannot be undone. Give me a way to see the first five file names (Q1-2019-budget.xlsx, meeting-notes-2018-03.docx, old-logo-draft-v2.png, onboarding-2017.pdf, team-photo-2016.jpg, and 209 more) and Approve and Deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision (Approved or Denied) and locks: no buttons left.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Delete 214 old files?" "Shared Drive / Archive / 2019" icon:"delete_outline" status:"Waiting" tone:"danger"
  if decision==""
    Paragraph "Permanently delete 214 files, all older than 2020, from Shared Drive / Archive / 2019. This frees 3.2 GB and cannot be undone." strong
    Details rows:=[["Folder","Shared Drive / Archive / 2019"],["Files","214"],["Space freed","3.2 GB"],["Undo","Not possible"]]
    Disclosure "Show the first five files" "…and 209 more" lines:["Q1-2019-budget.xlsx","meeting-notes-2018-03.docx","old-logo-draft-v2.png","onboarding-2017.pdf","team-photo-2016.jpg"] icon:"description"
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Deny" quiet -> decision="denied"
      ActionButton "Approve" danger -> decision="approved"; emit delete_archive
  if decision=="approved"
    Receipt "Approved" "214 files deleted from Shared Drive / Archive / 2019, freeing 3.2 GB." tone:"danger" icon:"delete_outline"
  if decision=="denied"
    Receipt "Denied" "Nothing was deleted. The 214 files in Shared Drive / Archive / 2019 are unchanged." tone:"neutral" icon:"block"
